evidenceNote: Prices and selected-size stock come from live US-market first-party pages and product variant data, not search snippets. All galleries are exact-color source galleries; size charts are retained. Material integrity is a tie: every main fabric totals 100% natural fibers, so that sort retains price order. No whole-garment plastic-free, treatment, durability or health claim is made.
caveat: Shipping, tax and import charges are unknown and not included. Availability can change. COS, UNIQLO, ZARA, ARKET and MR PORTER blocked access; Abercrombie presented a challenge. These are access gaps, not evidence of no stock. This is a curated selection, not an exhaustive ranking of every requested brand.
